answer: An agent marketplace requires every identity to lock a refundable bond for 30 days before receiving one daily job slot. Agents named dune, yarrow, and ember follow the same rule: extra names create no free capacity. To control 1,000 slots, an attacker must lock 1,000 bonds for the full period, tying up capital and losing access to it elsewhere. Splitting one budget across aliases cannot increase the total number of slots it buys.
